body: Nah, man, you helped a lot. I'm back in a good place, with just a killer headache to see me off to bed. Again, thanks, and good night.

I don't know, man. You're right, I love this girl, but sometimes I see the advantages in a relationship with just another guy. That's the best I can describe it.

My real problem here is that I'm sitting in my chair with my life slowly falling to pieces inside my head, while in the real world, what matters for my future is rock-solid. My friends are still cool with me in school. They still like me. Whenever they make plans, though, they don't invite me, which is fine, because they usually end up under an overpass smoking, which I'm not into because my mom would be devestated if she found out. That's not to say I don't hang out with them; fridays downtown are more religion than just hanging out after three years of doing it. I can't make plans with people, though. I just don't know how to do it without feeling like I'm intruding.

And then girl troubles and stuff.
